senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כתר a. עטר) [to circle,] to rise in circles, to smoke.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 6b:30">Ker. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>דבר שקוֹטֵר ועולה וריחו וכ׳</he> (not <he>שקיטר</he>) something which circles and rises, and whose savor spreads.
Ib. מה לשון קטרת דבר שקוטר ועולה ḳ’ṭoreth means something which circles &c.

senses.gloss: to offer incense (mostly with ref. to idolatrous rites).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 10:2">Tosef. Snh. X, 2</cite> <he>אחד העובד … ואחד המְקַטֵּר וכ׳</he> whether one worships (an idol), or sacrifices, or offers incense &c.; <cite ref="Keritot 3b">Ker. 3ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 3b:90">Ib.</cite> <he>מקטר לשד וכ׳</he> who makes incense rise to a demon in order to exorcise him; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 65a">Snh. 65ᵃ</cite>.
Lev. R. s. 7, v. infra; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְקוּטָּר; f. מְקוּטֶּרֶת perfumed.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 30:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXX</cite> (play on <cite ref="S00727"><he>קטורה</he></cite>) <he>שהיתה מק׳ מכל וכ׳</he> she was (through her good deeds) more savory than all kinds of spices; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:4">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>שמק׳ מצות וכ׳</he> she was perfumed with godly deeds and good works (v. <cite ref="S00825"><he>קָטַר</he> II</cite>).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="S00822">same</cite> (mostly with ref. to the Lord). [<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 10:3">Tosef. Snh. X, 3</cite> <he>והמקטיר</he>, prob. to be read: <he>והמְקַטֵּיר</he>.] <cite ref="Menachot 110a:3-6">Men. 110ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Malachi 1:11">Mal. I, 11</cite>) <he>אלו … כאילו מַקְטִירִין וכ׳</he> this refers to the students engaged in the Law; wherever it be, I account it to them as if they were offering incense and bringing sacrifices to my Name.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7">Lev. R. s. 7</cite> (ref. to <he>מקטר קטרת</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 30:1">Ex. XXX, 1</cite>) <he>מִתְקַטֵּר בקטרת אין כתיב כאן אלא מְקטֵּר … המזבח היה מַקְטִיר וכ׳</he> it says not ‘being perfumed with incense’, but ‘perfuming with incense’, the altar gave forth incense of itself.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:4">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>פעם … לְהַקְטִיר קטרת וכ׳</he> once I entered to let incense rise in the Holy of Holies; a. fr.
